app.name: Fuelx
app.tagline: Nutrition and strength & conditioning for club athletes, managed by their coaches.

landing.kicker: For clubs, teams and their athletes
landing.sub: Coaches add their athletes, upload InBody scans and set the season and match days. Every athlete gets a 4-week nutrition plan and a sport-specific strength & conditioning program that adjusts with weekly check-ins.
landing.price: {price} per athlete per month · cancel anytime

inbody.title: InBody in seconds
inbody.body: Coaches or athletes snap the scan. AI reads the numbers; you confirm them.

plan.title: Fuel for training and matches
plan.body: Exact macros for training, match and rest days, using Egyptian foods athletes actually eat.

train.title: Sport-specific S&C
train.body: Strength, power, speed and injury prevention built for the sport and season phase, planned around match days.

track.title: Calories left, live
track.body: Athletes tick off meals or log any food and see exactly how much they have left.

checkin.title: Coach dashboard
checkin.body: See every athlete's weight trend, adherence and check-ins, and who needs attention.

lang.title: عربي & English
lang.body: The whole app in Egyptian Arabic or English. Switch anytime.

landing.disclaimer: FUELX gives general fitness and nutrition guidance and is not medical advice. Check with a doctor if you have a medical condition.
landing.ctaTitle: Your squad's first 4-week plans are ready in minutes.

biomotor.title: Biomotor tests

back-squat-1rm.name: Back squat 1RM
back-squat-1rm.protocol: Heaviest single at full depth with good technique, or estimate it from a 3–5 rep max.

bench-press-1rm.name: Bench press 1RM
bench-press-1rm.protocol: Heaviest single with the bar touching the chest. Use a spotter.

handgrip.name: Handgrip strength
handgrip.protocol: Dynamometer, dominant hand, arm by the side. Best of 3.

push-ups.name: Max push-ups
push-ups.protocol: Most reps without rest, body straight, chest to fist height.

cmj.name: Countermovement jump
cmj.protocol: Hands on hips, dip and jump as high as possible. Best of 3.

broad-jump.name: Standing broad jump
broad-jump.protocol: Two-foot take-off and landing. Measure to the back heel. Best of 3.

mb-chest-throw.name: Medicine ball chest throw (3 kg)
mb-chest-throw.protocol: Seated with the back to a wall, push from the chest. Best of 3.

sprint-10m.name: 10 m sprint
sprint-10m.protocol: Standing start 0.5 m behind the line, timing gates if available. Best of 2.

sprint-30m.name: 30 m sprint
sprint-30m.protocol: Standing start 0.5 m behind the line. Best of 2 with full rest.

t-test.name: T-test
t-test.protocol: Sprint 10 m, shuffle 5 m left, 10 m right, 5 m left, backpedal 10 m.

pro-agility.name: 5-10-5 pro agility
pro-agility.protocol: Start on the middle line: 5 m one way, 10 m back, 5 m to finish. Touch each line.

illinois.name: Illinois agility test
illinois.protocol: 10 × 5 m course weaving through 4 cones, starting lying face down.

yoyo-ir1.name: Yo-Yo intermittent recovery 1
yoyo-ir1.protocol: Audio-paced 2 × 20 m shuttles with 10 s active recovery. Record total distance.

cooper-12min.name: Cooper 12-minute run
cooper-12min.protocol: Run as far as possible in 12 minutes on a measured track.

sit-and-reach.name: Sit and reach
sit-and-reach.protocol: Legs straight, reach slowly and hold 2 s. 0 cm = toes; short of the toes is negative.
